description: This Java class 'NettyMemoryMetrics' collects and exposes memory usage metrics from Netty's PooledByteBufAllocator, including general and verbose metrics related to memory allocations and deallocations.

classes.name: NettyMemoryMetrics
classes.description: A class implementing MetricSet to collect and expose Netty memory metrics, including general and verbose metrics from PooledByteBufAllocator.

methods.name: NettyMemoryMetrics
methods.description: Constructor initializing metrics collection with a PooledByteBufAllocator, metric prefix, and configuration.

methods.name: registerMetrics
methods.description: Registers general and verbose metrics from the allocator.

methods.name: registerArenaMetric
methods.description: Registers specific metrics for a given PoolArenaMetric, handling different return types.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable map of all collected metrics.
